description: Independent confirmation after the first conditional-tree study; same representation and optimization problem, new independent seeds and a fixed primary endpoint.
notes: Chosen after viewing the first tree study and committed before confirmation outcomes; not retrospective preregistration.
No changes to tree grammar, seed, task family, optimization, or selection rules.
Primary C=64, B=64; 4096 NEW development seed sets per family; do not pool discovery runs into confirmation intervals.
Three primary dividends have simultaneous 95% finite-sample empirical Bernstein intervals. Nine seed gains have a separate simultaneous 95% confidence family.
Uniform whole-program search remains in the reported results.
Local imports were factored into an isolated Boolean core with identical task semantics; deterministic replay is checked on a fixed small seed set.
